features.title: Publish the Client inspect manifest once per connection
features.summary: The native dynamic-package runner from one owned fork of the stock row. Behaviour is the native one; the page's inspect manifest is no longer sent before the connection is up and then again by the first reset: the first connected generation publishes it once, and every later generation publishes it again.
features.currentSurface: client: dynamic Cordis package runner (no UI)
failureModes: A page that is already connected at setup publishes at setup, as natively.
A refused manifest sync is logged by the native runner and retried by the next connection reset.

telemetry.reason: Client-only fork: it calls the native dynamicCordisRunner Remote methods whose Host spans belong to core; the Host half is the native no-op.
